title: A-S 366 - Hybrid Fabrication
description: A-S 366 is an intermediate level course that allows students to explore three-dimensional form through digital design and hybrid fabrication. Students will create sculpture from digital models using 3D printing, 3D scanning, CNC routing, and laser cutting. The goal of this course is to develop concepts and techniques of CAD modeling for use in 3D CAD/CAM processes as they apply to visual art, space, and design. Emphasis will be given to dealing with the use of current technology in combination with traditional sculpture processes in an artistic context. Six Studio hours per week.
prerequisites: A-S 103 and A-S 364 or consent of the instructor
